scope: source-data integrity and adapter integration smoke tests only; no strategy signals, strategy outcomes, PnL, or funded pass probability calculated
source: Dukascopy XAUUSD M5 BID/ASK GitHub Actions artifact #12031270051
gap_policy: allow only observed Friday-close to Sunday-reopen closures matching the archived session pattern; reject unexpected weekday/holiday gaps; never synthesize bars

cases: apply cutoff before paired-row matching
long entry uses ASK and mark uses BID low
short entry uses BID and mark uses ASK high
time/open exit is processed before new entry
favorable target gap fills at target cap
missing weekday M5 bar grid fails closed
wrong executable entry price fails closed
stop on wrong side of entry fails closed
adverse mark sorts before intrabar exit
force-close a position at exact cycle-end executable open
missing cycle-end quote fails closed
allow weekend closure without synthesizing bars
sequential two-phase completion requires five trading days per phase
completion by day 179 passes the project speed gate
completion on day 180 fails the project speed gate
daily loss includes current floating loss
static maximum loss floor
Quick Strike ratio can block phase completion
overlapping open-risk cap rejects second position
timezone-naive timestamps are rejected
Quick Strike share resets on a 14-day cycle rollover
positions auto-closed at 23:45 do not become fabricated rule breaches
missing cycle auto-close makes event path invalid
new entry at or after cycle end makes event path invalid
incomplete open-position path cannot count as a pass
cycle anchor derives from first accepted trade, not skipped signal

scenarios.name: one synthetic intraday position over real archived bars
one synthetic position spanning the real weekly market closure

limitations: This is not a strategy backtest or a FundedNext challenge replay.
A frozen strategy runner must provide the exact entry/exit ledger; none was evaluated here.
Per-unit additional friction is charged from entry for conservative intratrade risk checks; this is a model, not broker billing.
Broker/account commission, swap, contract-size conversion and exact server-time configuration remain unverified.
Adverse OHLC checkpoints cannot recover true tick order inside each candle.
Weekend gap handling is limited to the observed Friday-close/Sunday-reopen pattern. Other irregular closures fail closed.
